label: Smart display, Wi-Fi only
description: 7-inch smart display with Google Assistant, Sleep Sensing and a 802.11ac dual-band radio. No Ethernet and no PoE - it lives entirely on Wi-Fi.
notes: Wireless only, 802.11ac 2.4/5 GHz plus Bluetooth 5.0. Mains powered via 15 W adapter, no PoE. Uses mDNS and Google Cast, so multicast behaviour matters on the WLAN.
